title: United Nations General Assembly Resolution 44/240: Effects of the Military Intervention by the United States of America in Panama on the Situation in Central America
summary: Official United Nations General Assembly resolution adopted by a vote of 75 to 20 on December 29, 1989, strongly deploring the military intervention by the United States in Panama as a flagrant violation of international law and of the independence, sovereignty, and territorial integrity of states, and demanding an immediate cessation of the intervention and the withdrawal of US armed forces.
